title: limonium bahamense
intro: Limonium bahamense, commonly known as Bahamian sea lavender, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Limonium bahamense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic effects. Research on Limonium bahamense is ongoing, but its extracts have shown promise in supporting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress.
